The Subtask Name: Verify Zurracapote contains gin
Agents:
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Searched for Zurracapote ingredients using the query "Zurracapote ingredients recipe".
  -- Observation: Results included NYT Cooking and Spain.info pages listing ingredients like red wine, sugar, cinnamon, lemons, and dried fruits. No gin explicitly listed in initial snippets.
  -- Thought: Need to verify exact ingredients from authoritative sources to determine gin presence.
  -- Result: Initial search results suggest wine-based ingredients; gin not explicitly mentioned yet.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Opened the NYT Cooking Zurracapote page (https://cooking.nytimes.com/recipes/1014753-zurracapote) and extracted the full ingredient list.
  -- Observation: The recipe includes dry red wine, sugar, juniper berries, cinnamon, dried apricots, golden raisins, zurra red wine syrup, red wine, orange liqueur, vodka, lemons, apples, and Sprite. No gin listed.
  -- Thought: The recipe uses vodka and juniper berries but no explicit gin. Need to check other sources for variants.
  -- Result: Confirmed NYT recipe does not include gin; uses vodka instead.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Opened the Spain.info Zurracapote page (https://www.spain.info/en/recipe/zurracapote) and extracted the ingredient list.
  -- Observation: Ingredients listed are 4L red wine or clarete, 0.5L water, 0.5kg sugar, 0.5 cinnamon stick, 2 lemons. No gin or other spirits listed.
  -- Thought: Spain.info confirms a traditional wine-based recipe without gin.
  -- Result: Confirmed Spain.info recipe does not include gin.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Searched for additional Zurracapote recipes using queries like "Zurracapote receta ingredientes" and "Zurracapote gin".
  -- Observation: Results from Directo al Paladar and Bon Viveur listed ingredients as wine, cinnamon, sugar, and lemon. No gin mentioned.
  -- Thought: Multiple sources consistently show Zurracapote as a wine-based drink without gin.
  -- Result: Confirmed no gin in traditional Zurracapote recipes.
